onboarding.browseBody: Virtualized listing, inverse multi-select, and drag-and-drop uploads that keep folder trees.
onboarding.transferBody: Equal part sizes and resume support, built for R2 instead of generic S3.
onboarding.costBody: Class A/B counters in the session. Expensive listings are quoted first.

browser.sortDisabled: Size/date sort is disabled until the listing is fully loaded.
browser.selectBucketBody: Choose a bucket on the left, or create a new one.
browser.emptyFolderBody: Upload files, or drag local files into the window.
browser.truncated: Only part of this listing is loaded
browser.needOneFile: This works on a single file only
browser.downloadNoFolder: Folders cannot be downloaded. Select files only.
browser.confirmDeleteFolders: This will delete {{files}} file(s) and {{folders}} folder(s). Everything under those folders will be deleted. Listing keys uses Class A requests. This cannot be undone.

transfer.emptyBody: Uploads, downloads, and dropped files will show up here.

cost.quote: This will cost about {{count}} Class A calls. Browsing is 12.5× more expensive than downloads.

preview.unavailable: Preview is not available for this file type
preview.notFound: This object is missing or is not in the current bucket
preview.tooLarge: This file is too large to download for preview. Use a share link or download it.

control.createBucketDesc: Names are globally unique and cannot be renamed.
control.deleteBucketDesc: Only empty buckets can be deleted. This cannot be undone.
control.corsDesc: Allow browsers to access this bucket cross-origin. Comma-separated values.
control.lifecycleDesc: Expire objects under a prefix after a number of days.
control.devUrlHint: Append the object key to this URL. You can also copy a public link from the object list.
control.domainsDesc: Hostnames already bound to this bucket.
control.lockDesc: A lock can block overwrites or deletes. See Cloudflare for rule details.
control.metricsDesc: Account-level storage and request usage from Cloudflare REST (cached).
control.multipartDesc: Unfinished multipart uploads keep costing storage. Abort them when unused.
control.eventsDesc: Object-change notification config. Use advanced JSON for complex rules.
control.noBucketBody: Control-plane settings apply to the current bucket. Pick one in the sidebar or create one.
